guidance.visualIdea: This lesson is a re-skin of "语法斩 · 每次搞定一点": a light white ground (#f6f7fb), softly rounded surfaces, raised panels with a soft shadow and a airy layout. Reproduce that character, not a generic template.
colorRules: themeColors[0] (#315efb) is the primary accent, taken from the source's `--blue`.
themeColors[1] (#274f26) is the secondary, taken from the source palette.
themeColors[2] (#548a2c) is the attention colour, taken from the source palette.
themeColors[3] and themeColors[4] support the palette; do not introduce a colour outside these five.
Text uses #1b2842, taken from the source's `--ink`; secondary text is #788397, from the source's `--muted`.
Surfaces use #eef3ff (recessed areas #d5ff6b99), separated by #e7eaf2 hairlines.
Roles the source did not name as variables — surface, surfaceAlt, secondary, accent — were inferred from which colours the stylesheet uses most; treat them as the weakest part of this palette.
typographyRules: The typeface is Noto Sans SC, mapped from the source's own font stack onto a family this product loads.
Type scale: 45 for a cover title, 36 for an in-page headline, 22 for body copy, 16 for captions.
The source is a web page; its px sizes were scaled to slide units and clamped for projection legibility. Follow the numbers above, not the source page's CSS.
layoutRules: Keep a 26-unit safe margin; the source page's whitespace ratio is airy.
Decoration: softly rounded corners, raised panels with a soft shadow, accents in #315efb.
The source keeps its content on raised cards; a quiet folio is enough
avoid: Colours, fonts or corner radii that are not in this palette — the whole point of this style is that it matches the source.
Heavy dark panels; the source keeps its ground light.
Dense, edge-to-edge layouts; the source leaves the margins above.
